property_summary: For every caller who is the owner, calling updateAlloSettings(newAlloSettings) sets c.alloSettings() equal to the provided newAlloSettings; the mutant instead sets alloSettings to address(0) and thus will violate this for any non-zero newAlloSettings.
change_summary: Change assignment in updateAlloSettings to set alloSettings to address(0) instead of the provided newAlloSettings parameter.
